notes.title: Blast Brigade | Patch Notes (April 29, 2022)
notes.content:
A new update is available for Blast Brigade vs. the Evil Legion of Dr. Cread. The latest version of the game contains the following changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with a door which could be closed after death in Temple of the Sacred Trial location.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused an invisible cutscene after defeating the DOMINANT OVERSEER boss.
[*] Fixed a bug with getting the final achievement when playing with multiple save slots.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could be pinned down by the generator in the Screaming Cliffs puzzle.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused incorrect gold fly spawn during the final boss fight.
[*] Fixed incorrect flower enemy behaviour.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the first gun to disappear for early access players.
[*] Minor visual, audio, and localization fixes.
[/list]
Enjoying Blast Brigade? Join a worldwide network of BLAST agents over on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/wvDvMqpabh]official Blast Brigade Discord server[/url]!

notes.title: Save 15% This Black Friday & Enjoy New Improvements!
notes.content:
If you’re a fan of classic metroidvania games, we’ve got an exclusive Black Friday deal just for you… [b]Save 15%[/b] on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550760/Blast_Brigade_vs_the_Evil_Legion_of_Dr_Cread/]Blast Brigade vs. the Evil Legion of Dr. Cread[/url], now available on Steam Early Access with a [b]free Original Soundtrack[/b]!

This 2D action-adventure is inspired by its metroidvania progenitors and the popcorn-chomping thrills of '80s action flicks. Assemble a crack team of heroes and use your platforming skills and puzzle-solving wits to traverse unique biomes. Arm yourself with upgradeable weapons, bulk yourself up with perks, and embark on a daring mission to save the world from a mad scientist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550760/Blast_Brigade_vs_the_Evil_Legion_of_Dr_Cread/

And if you’ve already been initiated into BLAST, this exclusive Black Friday discount coincides with a new update featuring [b]several improvements[/b]:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing invulnerability of the Icarus boss. He shouldn’t have flown so close to the sun!
[*] Fixed a bug related to obtaining the "Cartographer" Achievement. Set course for victory!
[*] Fixed a bug related to obtaining the "Treasure Hunter" Achievement. Enjoy the booty!
[/list]
If you’re new to Blast Brigade, you can kickstart your mission in the Early Access version by recruiting playable heroes Jeff and Shura. Explore six mysterious and dangerous biomes, from frosty mountains to golden beaches, frightening laboratories, and dense jungles, and do battle with up to 30 unique enemy types that can be found around Cread’s island. Seven killer bosses—a fiendish line-up featuring a cyborg, ninja, and monstrous mutants—also lie in wait to battle unsuspecting heroes!

ICYMI: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1550760/view/3115923449101536056]read up on future Blast Brigade content[/url] declassified from the BLAST archives, including details about new locations, a sinister boss, and the double-jump ability!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40467578/f6d9ad3cc41c6d557d11101e79bbc91504345145.jpg[/img]

We’d love to hear your thoughts about the game, so be sure to connect with other players and share your feedback directly with us via the [url=https://discord.gg/wvDvMqpabh]official Blast Brigade Discord server[/url] and the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1550760]Blast Brigade Steam Community[/url].

notes.title: BLAST Declassified: New Content Reveal!
notes.content:
Psst… wanna sneak a peek at some declassified info fresh from the BLAST archives?

[h1]NEW LOCATION: SCREAMING CLIFFS[/h1]
Venture to the looming precipices of Cread’s island to take down his henchmen by any means necessary!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40467578/69dc10405315f7b36f50969f8a915398f2a3d0f7.png[/img]

On the far side of the island lies the Cove, an inaccessible region full of towering, precarious cliffs beaten by strong ocean waves. A long time ago, part of the island was said to have broken off here and sunk below into the watery depths. Traces of the ancient civilization that once lived here remain on the Screaming Cliffs, though Cread’s minions have since made it their home and a base from which to search for the lost underwater ruins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40467578/5e35f514076c490b04c13dffb4bdb138739473fb.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW LOCATION: TEMPLE OF THE SACRED TRIAL[/h1]
Delve deeper into the island secrets as you enter the The Temple of the Sacred Trial! A stronghold of the Sacred Defenders, this ancient shrine harbors arcane architecture that has remained unchanged for millennia, with its winding passages, puzzles, traps, and ancient guardians serving as a deadly trial for any would-be Champions worthy of wielding the hallowed Chakram.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40467578/14f02f51484b4d9bc702c8c0c726dfbccf9637fb.jpg[/img]

Should you make it to the large central chamber of the Temple, you will uncover what the Ancients were protecting and find out more about Cread’s true interests in the island...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40467578/073a63cd5665fc82531e32e5a12d08d561394c48.png[/img]

[h1]NEW BOSS: OVERSEER[/h1]
Donna Smith was once one of the CIA’s rising stars. Despite her young age, her technical ingenuity saw her meteoric rise through the ranks to a position overseeing highly illegal mass global surveillance. When the press caught wind of her department’s activities, her superiors threw her to the wolves as a scapegoat, and she was sentenced to life in prison. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40467578/422ea122aff8fbf12a51cb7a3fd8cd01f9dd9a17.png[/img]

However, she quickly adapted to her new surroundings, broke free, and disappeared without a trace. Disillusioned with the world, she turned her considerable skills to espionage and crime, eventually joining Dr. Cread’s ranks. He granted her cybernetic augmentations to make her one of the most dangerous surveillance experts in the world, and under the villainous new moniker The Overseer, she now monitors all from her flying observation chair. We’d recommend not tangling with this femme fatale, but you won’t have a choice if you want to stop Cread once and for all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40467578/46279049167d116d6123c3d72fd27604b3a02092.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW ABILITY: DOUBLE JUMP[/h1]
A core metroidvania mechanic comes to Blast Brigade! Scale previously unpassable chasms and platforms, conquer new heights, and navigate new areas like the Screaming Cliffs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40467578/a3addbbadce9e0b701fd3d8a3e47425f825d8b60.jpg[/img]

That’s all we’ve got for now! Blast Brigade vs. the Evil Legion of Dr. Cread is now available to play in Early Access. Keep an eye on Steam and our official channels for more information about the launch of the full game, but for now… Have a blast!
